artifactFindings.networkAuditLimit: No staging URL/build, CTA-by-CTA action list, interceptor configuration, HAR, or request timeline. The only recorded URL is production.

liveDiagnostic.realTapAttempts: Two page.touchscreen.tap attempts timed out; after each, selected value remained 8, variation ID 298, price visible. This is recorded as inconclusive tool/runtime behavior, not alone as a site failure.

syntheticTouchend.interpretation: The explicit touchend guard only clears ID/hides/locks; it does not reset the select. It relies on the subsequent synthesized click/WooCommerce handler to complete reset.

liveDiagnostic.liveImplementation: jQuery handler is bound to both click and touchend; MutationObserver watches childList/subtree and enforces hidden/disabled when variation ID is empty.
